description: Planaria exposed to barium, which blocks potassium channels and destroys their heads, regenerated barium-insensitive heads by changing the expression of a small number of genes (Levin's summary of Emmons-Bell et al. 2019).
limitations: Reported secondhand here. Whether the response counts as problem-solving is an interpretation.
